verdict.rationale: Cloudflare claims Workers fit existing workflows and frameworks with "no proprietary tools or vendor lock-in" (cloudflare-docs-17, cloudflare-docs-6), and the runtime is built on the open-source workerd (cloudflare-gh-1). However, storage is reached through Cloudflare-specific Bindings like KV and D1 (cloudflare-docs-10, cloudflare-docs-4). A community report says those locked-in services made switching hard (cloudflare-comm-10), and another notes the lack of a full Node runtime blocks migration (cloudflare-comm-13). Missing for 10: documentation of standards-based runtime APIs (e.g., WinterCG/web-standard compatibility), portable storage abstractions, and evidence of the same code running unmodified on other edge platforms.
